description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Toolbox hooks and the context map
phases.notes: Edicts 0016 (the toolbox fires itself) and 0015 (the context map). 0016's hook kit comes first; 0015's context hook is a feature of it.

activePhase.title: Toolbox hooks and the context map
activePhase.goal: Build edicts 0016 and 0015 to their acceptance criteria: a stdlib hook kit that makes Daedalus's tools fire at exact events, and an exact context map with planned compaction, recovery and recall.
activePhase.sequencing: Kit first (T-h1, T-h2), then 0015's measuring and views (T-c1..T-c2) so the context feature has a home, then the 0016 triggers (T-h3..T-h7) and 0015's plan, nudges, recovery and recall (T-c3..T-c5), docs last (T-h8, covering both edicts). Rebase on the night shift's work; it owns ophanic/, cli/oph.py and the end of doctor.run_checks.

tasks.title: Hook kit: daedalus_hookkit, dispatchers, registration, state, budget, fail-soft
tasks.details: Top-level stdlib package + daedalus-hook script; <=40 ms median subprocess on the no-feature event; HOOKS gains a matcher; board and capture move onto it; Stop/PreCompact never print. | PR #74 (a6b88b6, 3bded53): kit built; Momus D1-D4 fixed, re-review running.

tasks.title: Efficacy logging, hookstate.load, digest counts
tasks.details: Events log shape agreed with the TUI session (daedalus-3b); followed within hooks.efficacy_window; per-agent/per-skill counts in digests. | PR #74: efficacy, hookstate.load, digest schema 4 (agent_calls, skill_calls, hooks).

tasks.title: Context measuring: offset reader, index, exact attribution, base, subagent reports
tasks.details: Reuse digest.py; output_tokens to their own line; totals reset at compact_boundary; cold start in slices. | PR #75 (d84252f, stacked on #74): exact measuring and incremental index; Momus review running.

tasks.title: Context views, library functions (measure/plan/pin), CLI
tasks.details: By subject and by task, quiet share, stable keys; JSON shape agreed with the TUI session. | PR #75: context.measure (TUI shape), daedalus context CLI.

tasks.title: Momus gate at merge, Covers line in momus.md, PR recording at gh pr create
tasks.details: Default gate, opt-out; skips logged; gh pr view fallback with 5 s timeout; trials under CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.

tasks.title: Gameplan capture at commit and merge; pending proposals in the brief; doctor hints
tasks.details: hooks.capture defaults on; doctor: hooks not registered, worktree without settings, stale proposals.

tasks.title: Memory lookup on mentions and questions
tasks.details: Deterministic grep, <=3 hits, quoted, once per cycle; memory_lookup group in PROJECT_SETTING_GROUPS.

tasks.title: Inhale after compaction made specific; reflection-due line
tasks.details: Compaction times in session state; due.json staleness rule.

tasks.title: Palace graph cache; tests for the commit
tasks.details: mtime/size-keyed pickle under the cache dir; skip over 300 ms.

tasks.title: Context plan: marks, pins, instructions, saved per boundary
tasks.details: keep > record first > drop > summarize; 1,500-char instructions keep identifiers first.

tasks.title: Context nudges as a kit feature: breakpoint and warn
tasks.details: Within context.nudge_minutes and hooks.budget_per_hour; PostToolUse only.

tasks.title: Recovery after compaction, recall, check
tasks.details: SessionStart(compact) block <=800 chars; recall from transcript UUIDs per boundary.

tasks.details: Also 0015's README and exhale-skill criteria; send the TUI session the watched file paths; tell it when the kit's clock can replace clock.sh (needs 0014).
